This '''Mandalorian super commando''' was a member of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]. The warrior was stationed in the [[Royal prison/Legends|prison]] section of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]].

==History==
After building up an army of criminals including the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], and [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his army of criminals [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|attacked]] [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] so the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] could come in and stop them so they could take control of the [[Mandalore/Legends|planet]]. After betraying Maul and the locking him away in [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]], Maul escaped and returned to [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] with his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]]. Maul [[Death/Legends|slayed]] the leader of the Death Watch at that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], and took control of the band of warriors. This [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commando]] was one of the many who aligned with Maul after Vizsla's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="The Lawless" />

Later, the Mandalorian changed their armor to give it a red design to honor the new leader of the Death Watch. After [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] gained the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of [[Unidentified Mandalorian super commando 1|another super commando]], he rescued [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] from her [[Prison/Legends|cell]]. They met with this commando in a [[Turbolift/Legends|lift]]. Kenobi pretended that Satine was taken to another cell. However, when this commando asked the authorization code from Kenobi, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] had to kick out the commando, knocking them unconscious, so he and Satine could escape.<ref name="The Lawless" />
